theme: Last open day in Croatia before the flight home.
greeting: A free day in Cavtat, Dan - the sailing week is behind you and the girls are with Jen this stretch, so today is genuinely yours. The one thing worth doing before you rest: lock the two Florida bookings that bite the moment you land tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Two nights in St Pete, still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: You land Tampa tomorrow afternoon, but the nights of the 20th and 21st have no room yet and the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday. On the Mike + Dan board, p1, overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: No rental car for the Tampa landing
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20 - Oct 5 full-size SUV is decided but not booked; arriving at 3:55 PM Sunday without one means walk-up rates, jet-lagged, on a Sunday. Mike + Dan board, p1, overdue since Sept 9.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early - book it refundable now, adjust dates later. Mike + Dan board, p1, overdue since Sept 14.

flagged.title: Venmo request from Joshua Weaver
flagged.detail: He requested $50 for mowing on 9/17 - a quick approve once you're back online.

inbox.noise: Otherwise it's newsletters, travel receipts, and subscription renewals - nothing that needs you.
inbox.clear: No one is waiting on a reply.

resolved.title: Ride home is booked
resolved.detail: Uber confirmed a 5:35 AM pickup from the hotel for tomorrow's early flight.

recipe.title: Ginger spice cake with dried cherries
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans into the season's roots, squash, and slow-cooked warmth.

tasks.title: Grocery stop before the Orlando villa

acts.line: You disembarked the charter and rode into Cavtat this morning - the sailing week is behind you.
Nothing on the calendar - a rare open stretch and the last of the Adriatic before you fly.
An early night ahead: the airport pickup is set for 5:35 AM for the flight home to Tampa.
